question: What actual public data can support an honest TrialTrace app without inventing patient timelines?

sources.method: Native curl HTTP GET, exact response retained in local scratch
sources.result: HTTP 200; study/protocol identity, sponsor, status, enrollment, aggregate-result modules and protocol document metadata retrieved
NLM recommends the official single-study API for JSON study data and describes API content as metadata/statistics
JavaScript application shell was returned; API method was corroborated using NLM guidance and actual endpoint execution

implementation_effect: Use a real-source registry card and linked protocol while labeling all participant-style CSVs and timing results synthetic draft engineering. Do not infer or fabricate real participant events from aggregate registry results.
uncertainty: Registry and PDF identity agreement does not independently approve clinical/source interpretation or demonstrate that synthetic mappings apply to real people.
